pubs.name: Gallagher's Traditional Pub
pubs.description: Historic military-themed pub from the 1820s with a barber shop inside. Irish-owned establishment known for traditional atmosphere and real ale.

pubs.name: Bow-Legged Beagle
pubs.description: Award-winning micro pub celebrating locally produced cask and craft ale. First opened on New Brighton's Victoria Road, now with multiple locations across Merseyside.

pubs.name: The Coop
pubs.description: Old school pub on College Road with Canadian maple flooring, low lighting and a welcoming bookcase. Opened October 2023 and quickly became a local favourite.

pubs.name: Beer Station
pubs.description: Compact pub near Freshfield station on Victoria Road in Formby. Known for quality real ale selection in an intimate setting.

pubs.name: The Philharmonic Dining Rooms
pubs.description: Historic Victorian pub in Liverpool's city centre, known for its ornate interior and classic real ale selection.

pubs.name: The White Star Pub
pubs.description: Traditional pub with nautical heritage, serving quality real ales and local beers in a welcoming atmosphere.

pubs.name: The Athenaeum
pubs.description: Grade II listed Georgian building housing a distinctive pub with character and an excellent selection of real ales.

pubs.name: The Grapes
pubs.description: Waterfront pub with views and a selection of quality real ales. Popular meeting spot for locals and visitors alike.

pubs.name: The Gate Inn
pubs.description: Community pub off the beaten track, offering genuine local hospitality and a fine selection of real ales.

pubs.name: The Beehive
pubs.description: Traditional community pub serving the Bebington area with quality real ales and a warm welcome.
